response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has deep technical expertise in developer tools, testing infrastructure, CI/CD, and even mobile platforms (iOS/Apple TV), which aligns well with the technical scope of this role. However, his 15+ year career is entirely individual-contributor focused — there is no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership responsibilities, which are core, non-negotiable requirements for this Engineering Manager position.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools, test frameworks (Trial, Fluent-Asserts), and CI/CD infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and backend systems, including direct iOS/Apple TV app ownership
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentoring through workshops, talks, and internal training sessions
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct report responsibilities anywhere in his career history
Career progression has stayed purely IC-track (Staff/Senior Developer titles) with no team-lead or managerial titles
No mention of organizational change leadership, performance expectation setting, or roadmap ownership at a managerial level

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tools & testing infrastructure background
